questions.question: Must the full printed Resting Point budget be spent?
questions.answer: Yes. The attributable designer clarification says to spend all Resting Points supplied by the Quest.

questions.question: Can a Rest begin if recoverable Life plus Stress is less than the printed budget?
Can a Rest finish when recoverable Life plus Stress is less than the printed budget?
Can excess points be assigned without a recovery effect?
Can excess points be discarded or wasted?
Does spend require an actual recovery target?
questions.answer: The Rest paragraph couples each point spent to recovering Life or Stress, but neither it nor a general rule uniquely resolves whether an excess point can be spent without effect.

questions.question: Can players intentionally allocate fewer points?
questions.answer: No. Voluntary partial allocation conflicts with the designer instruction to spend all Resting Points supplied by the Quest.

questions.question: Does a zero-recovery Rest consume Firewood?
questions.answer: A completed Rest consumes Firewood, but whether a Rest with zero recoverable capacity can legally begin or complete is unresolved.

questions.question: Does reaching full Life or zero Stress during Rest alter the remaining budget?
